tagline.en_US: Self-hosted photo library that indexes local photo collections and keeps its thumbnail cache in persistent storage.

description.en_US: Photofield is a self-hosted photo gallery and viewer designed to display large collections of images smoothly and quickly. It features a seamless zoomable interface with progressive multi-resolution image loading across various customizable layouts. The software operates read-only on local photo directories, indexing metadata, colors, and reverse geolocation data without altering the source files.
